fishing: WHEN: Wednesday Oct 14, moving water preferred (dawn/dusk). PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/09 small mangrove snapper and grunts around Placida trestle; tarpon and snook hanging in Gasparilla Pass. Surf mixed/no fresh reports. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper around Chadwick Park Pier and docks, redfish and small snook on random docks/flats, trout on grass. NEARSHORE: Florida Sportsman Oct 9-12 excellent redfish schooling on flats (live pilchards/shrimp), decent snook and black drum in passes. Capt. Mike no fresh Oct note. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, soft plastics, cut bait, gold spoons, crabs.
redtide: FWC Oct 9: K. brevis background to very low in 11 Gulf samples. SWFL: background Pinellas/Manatee, background to very low Sarasota (in/offshore), background and very low Charlotte, background offshore Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 16.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD, latest sample ~20 CFU/100mL (Healthy Beaches/DOH Charlotte). No advisory. Manasota Key / Palm Island also GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte County ~2-23 customers out (minor); Sarasota ~20-149 outages (minor, no major Englewood/Manasota spike).
